 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. ALLSTON, Mass. - Boston College men's basketball looks to improve to 5-0 in non-conference play as they take on the Harvard Crimson (2-3) at Lavietes Pavilion Wednesday night.
 It's the Eagles' first road game of the season, with all four of their wins thus far coming in Conte Forum or on neutral ground. Last time out, the Eagles defeated New Hampshire 67-55 on Sunday .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Harvard is looking to get back in the win column following three consecutive defeats, falling to Northeastern in overtime, as well as George Washington and American University.
 Going into Wednesday's contest, BC ranks third in the nation in free-throw percentage, converting at an 86.5 percent rate from the line, including third in scoring defense, allowing just 53.5 points per game.
 The Eagles lead the all-time series between the two Massachusetts foes, 37-16, and have won the last two matchups and four of the last five.
 Last year, BC faced Harvard in Conte Forum on Nov. 26, 2025, winning 73-60 behind Fred Payne's game-high 17 points.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Below is a live thread of the game with scoring, analysis, lineups and more.
 Scoring Rundown and Analysis
 [This section will be updated throughout the game, refresh for up-to-date information] 
 First Half 
 16:17: Eagles start off hot on a 9-0 run, as Tommy Amaker calls his first timeout. Eagles have played suffocating defense early on, forcing four turnovers. Armoni Zeigler finds a great pass out to Ernest Shelton for a corner three, and Brandon Benjamin makes good use of his physicality on the interior after Luke Hunger picks up two early fouls.
 11:46: ak Smrekar hits his first three of the day to extend BC's lead to double digits for the first time, Eagles lead 14-2.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 9:12: Harvard picks up a couple of baskets courtesy of Robert Hinton and Tey Barbour to cut the lead to 14-6, as Armoni Zeigler commits BC's seventh foul of the half. None have been shooting fouls; Harvard is now in the bonus.
 5:11 Boston College's off-ball fouls continue to punish them on the defensive end, as Jason Singleton goes perfect from the line to make it a 23-14 ballgame in favor of the Eagles. Colby Duggan has done well on a couple of drives offensively for BC, and Brandon Benjamin gets second-chance points on one, his fifth offensive board of the half.
 3:00: The two sides have gone back and forth in an early defensive battle, but the Eagles have begun to assert their dominance in their paint, as Jacob Furphy finds the cutting Duggan for an easy two, and then Luke Hunger earns a trip to the line, Eagles lead 27-16.
 0:39 Probably the offensive highlight of the first half, Smrekar sends a defender flying with a pump fake from the elbow and finishes with contact in the lane, converting the and-one opportunity at the line, putting the BC lead at 30-20.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 0:00: Boston College enters the half with a 30-22 lead over the Crimson, led by 10 points from ak Smrekar.
 Second Half 
 18:20 : Boston College begins the half with a pair of and-ones, first from Luke Hunger and then an emphatic slam from Ernest Shelton, which was off the back of Armoni Zeigler's sixth assist of the day, 36-25 Boston College.
 15:17: Luke Hunger has called his own number a lot to start this second half, finding mismatches in the paint and drawing fouls, as he earns a trip to the line following the media timeout. Tay Barbour hits a pair of threes after a quiet opening half, now up to 12 points on the day, Eagles still lead 40-31.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 13:18: Luke Murray uses his first timeout of the day, after Jason Singleton got past Armoni Zeigler twice, and a Zeigler turnover would result in a transition bucket for Robert Hinton, cutting the Boston College lead down to six, the smallest lead since 9:12 in the first half.
 9:05: A pair of Ben Eisendrath free throws draws Harvard to within two, 54-52 Boston College leads.
 6:55: Harvard takes first lead of the day as Robert Hinton hits a contested three to put the Crimson up, 57-56.
 2:56: Jacob Furphy uses his physicality down low to give the Eagles a two point lead, 65-63, at the media timeout.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 1:23: Eagles lead back out to four, as Colby Duggan passes up a three (with the Eagles shooting 4-23 from deep) to find Brandon Benjamin in the paint for an easy two, 69-65 lead for BC.
 0:00: A Thomas Batties II three would put things in reach for the Crimson, but they were unable to equalize, Boston College wins 74-69 thanks to more good free throw shooting down the stretch.

 Injury Updates
 [This section will be updated throughout the game, refresh for up-to-date information] 
 Boston College's Money Williams will be out again tonight, according to CBS Sports' Jon Rothstein. Williams was out against New Hampshire after picking up an injury in the second half against Maryland Eastern Shore.
